sources.title: OSS consistency
sources.bounded_support: Single-object atomicity and strong consistency; not a multi-object transaction.

sources.title: OSS PutObject
sources.bounded_support: Flat namespace; 5 GB simple upload; forbid-overwrite is invalid with versioning enabled or suspended.

sources.title: CDN origin rewrite
sources.bounded_support: Origin URI rewrite does not change cache key; up to 50 rules; ordering matters.

sources.title: CDN cache
sources.bounded_support: Origin no-cache honored unless ignored; prior cache rules stay with already-cached objects.

sources.title: CDN refresh
sources.bounded_support: Invalidation tasks and soft purge/304 semantics; not a transaction or all-POP instantaneous guarantee.

sources.title: Private OSS origin
sources.bounded_support: STS same-account origin fetch; documented default role example has account-wide List*/Get*; domain can expose bucket resources.

sources.title: OSS/CDN integration
sources.bounded_support: Origin Host must match; cache can hide misconfigured origin; verify uncached origin access before traffic switch.

sources.title: CDN configuration API
sources.bounded_support: Domain-level action; ConfigId=0 means not applied; table lists ram:CreateServiceLinkedRole dependency, no function-specific condition key.

sources.title: Debian repository format
sources.bounded_support: By-hash current mandatory and at least two prior index versions recommended. Search retrieval available; direct open was 403.

sources.title: DNF configuration
sources.bounded_support: Native mirrorlist, baseurl, repo_gpgcheck, gpgcheck, metadata_expire options. Does not by itself prove pinned distro A/B request trace.
